briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies ahead of Q3 benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid escalating compute investments. Multi-agent systems dominate development priorities as safety gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-V4 and xAI Grok-3 close capability gaps in reasoning benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell; Microsoft and Google announce $45B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization in the EU and US slow the AGI timeline or merely shift leadership to less-regulated jurisdictions?
